newsitem.title: USA: Electric Lightwave gets Idaho telecom OK.
newsitem.headline: Electric Lightwave gets Idaho telecom OK.

text.p: Electric Lightwave Inc, a unit of Citizens Utilities Co, said Thursday that the Idaho Public Utilities Commission has approved its application to provide telecommunications services.
The company said it is authorized to provide interexchange long distance and private line services to business customers with six or more lines in Ada, Canyon, Boise and Elmore Counties.

The company said additionally that it plans to complete construction of its central switching office and offer dial tone service and a host of other telecommunications services including ISDN and Frame Relay in early 1998.
